title: Digital clock middle-click calendar launches korganizer-view rather than korganizer. It crashes (missing --view argument)
line: Middle-clicking the clock opens the real calendar app instead of a hidden helper like KOrganizer View that fails without a file
explanation: The digital clock took the single preferred text/calendar handler, even when it was a NoDisplay helper such as openSUSE's default korganizer-view.desktop (Exec=korganizer --view %u). Middle-click then ran "korganizer --view" with no file, which exits at once, so nothing opened. The change (MR !7320) queries all text/calendar handlers in preference order and takes the first that isn't NoDisplay.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: Skip NoDisplay helpers when picking the calendar app

Only the preferred text/calendar handler was used, so a NoDisplay helper
like "KOrganizer View" made the clock run "korganizer --view" without a
file. Now the most preferred calendar handler that isn't hidden is used.

BUG: 523596

media.caption: Master, default calendar set to the hidden KOrganizer View: the tooltip offers to open "KOrganizer View"
With the fix, same settings: the tooltip offers the real KOrganizer
Master: after middle-click nothing opens; the helper ran as 'korganizer --view' with no file and exited
With the fix: middle-click opens the KOrganizer stand-in window
